description: Estimate land transfer tax on a home purchase for all 13 provinces and territories (incl. Toronto MLTT, Montreal welcome tax), first-time buyer rebates, plus the transfer registration fee (the government fee to register the deed) and the total due at registration. Alberta, Saskatchewan, Newfoundland & Labrador and the three territories charge no land transfer tax, only the registration fee. The mortgage registration fee is separate and not included.

inToronto.description: Ontario only: property is within the City of Toronto (adds the municipal LTT)

quebecMunicipality.description: Quebec only: 'montreal' uses Montreal's welcome-tax brackets (the website's Quebec default); 'other' uses the provincial base schedule for municipalities without higher rates above $500,000
